title: Brown Eyed Girl | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Newly Renovated Lake Front Home with Private Pool- Brown Eyed Girl by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Brown Eyed Girl by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Details: Brown Eyed Girl is a stunning Eastern Lake retreat designed for effortless coastal living. The beautifully remodeled interior pairs refined luxury with modern style, while the outdoor spaces are made for enjoying everything 30A has to offer. Walls of glass open to expansive lakefront living, a serene pool, and unforgettable views, creating a seamless indoor–outdoor experience perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Upstairs offers generous space complemented by a master bathroom featuring a luxurious steam shower. One of the home’s most loved features is how easy it is to enjoy the water. Complimentary paddleboards make it simple to glide across Eastern Lake straight to the beach access, turning a day at the Gulf into part of the adventure (and for those who prefer to stay on foot, the beach is just a short walk away). With a private dock for fishing, sunsets, and paddling, plus inviting outdoor areas designed for gathering, this home delivers the ultimate Seagrove Beach experience, beautiful inside and out, and perfectly positioned for lake-to-beach living. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Fully renovated lakefront home, completed early 2026. - Located in Seagrove Beach on scenic Eastern Lake. - Short walking distance to Walton Dunes Beach Access and Port Property Beach Access. - Complimentary BOTE paddleboards with an easy paddle across the lake to beach access. - Private lakeside pool with optional pool heat for additional cost*. - Spacious decks with beautiful lake views and ample outdoor seating. - Generous indoor and outdoor dining areas. - 6 bikes for exploring the area. - Short distance to dining at Old Florida Fish House and shopping at Greenway Station. - Parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway. - Coffee maker provided. *Pool heat available for additional cost. Please contact our reservations team for additional details. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 16 6 Bedrooms / 4 Full & 1 Half Bath First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Dual Vanity) Porch -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room / Half Path / Pool Deck Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Porch with Lake Views -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Dual Vanity) -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Twin/Twin Bunk and Shared Bath (Shower/Dual Vanity) Porch with Lake Views -Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 6: Bunk Room with Two Sets of Twin/Twin Bunks with Shared Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Laundry Room Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
